caption: Ausgaben des Bundes für Sicherheit
model_annotation: The graph illustrates the expenditures of the Federal Government on security from 2015 to 2025, comparing three categories: "Äußere Sicherheit" (External Security), "Innere Sicherheit" (Internal Security), and "Abwehr hybrider Gefahren" (Defense against Hybrid Threats). The x-axis represents the years from 2015 to 2025, with a linear scale and tick labels at every year. The y-axis represents the expenditure values, ranging from 0 to 180, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. The "Äußere Sicherheit" line is depicted in blue, starting at around 70 in 2015 and increasing to approximately 100 by 2020, before slightly decreasing to around 95 by 2024 and 2025. The "Innere Sicherheit" line is shown in purple, beginning at around 80 in 2015, rising to about 100 by 2020, and then stabilizing around 100 until 2025. The "Abwehr hybrider Gefahren" line is represented in green, starting at around 40 in 2015 and steadily increasing to approximately 160 by 2022, before dropping to around 110 in 2024 and rising again to about 130 in 2025.
